name: gynecology
description: Datenpaket für Gynäkologen: Zyklus, Temperatur-Abweichung, Medikamente
description_en: Data package for gynecologists: cycle, temperature deviation, medications

queries.reproductive_events: SELECT date, event_type, value_num, value_text, source FROM reproductive_health WHERE person = :person AND date BETWEEN :date_from AND :date_to ORDER BY date
queries.cycle_symptoms: SELECT date, symptom, value_num, value_text, category FROM symptoms WHERE person = :person AND (category IN ('Zyklus','Reproductive') OR symptom LIKE '%menstrual%' OR symptom LIKE '%cramp%' OR symptom LIKE '%bloat%' OR symptom LIKE '%breast_pain%' OR symptom LIKE '%pelvic_pain%') AND date BETWEEN :date_from AND :date_to ORDER BY date
queries.temp_deviation: SELECT date, ts, value, source_app FROM measurements WHERE metric IN ('temp_deviation','wrist_temp_sleep') AND person = :person AND date BETWEEN :date_from AND :date_to ORDER BY ts
queries.contraception_oura: SELECT id, method, method_start_date, method_end_date, timestamp FROM oura_contraception WHERE method_start_date <= :date_to OR method_end_date >= :date_from ORDER BY method_start_date
queries.medications_hormonal: SELECT ts, date, drug_name, dose_value, dose_unit, route FROM medications WHERE person = :person AND date BETWEEN :date_from AND :date_to ORDER BY ts
